subject: Ascend AI renewal & onboarding credits
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Peter Lang <peter@ascend.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Ascend AI renewal & onboarding credits

Hi Peter —

Great catching up earlier this week. Per our conversation, I wanted to outline a renewal framework that supports Ascend's planned capacity growth while protecting unit economics on both sides. High level proposal: 

- Term: 12 months, starting 2027-06-01.
- Commit: 1.2M inference units (approx. 20% YoY uplift from current run rate).
- Pricing: three-tier discount bands by monthly usage (0-70% of commit = list, 70-100% = 5% discount, >100% = 10% discounted overage pricing).
- Onboarding concession: one-time $40k onboarding credit to offset migration and engineering hours.
- Burst protection: 60-day onboarding waiver for surge overages (no overage charges for first 60 days after go-live), then standard overage rules apply.

We can formalize this as an amendment to the existing SOW with a simple term sheet. Two asks from your side: confirmation on the target commit and whether the 60-day burst waiver covers your immediate production ramp.

I'll loop in Monica and Karthik to finalize legal/finance-friendly language and produce a term sheet. If this looks directionally right, I'll send an updated PDF and DocuSign link by tomorrow.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: usage snapshot requested (ascend_usage_Q1_2027.csv)
From: Peter Lang <peter@ascend.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ascend AI renewal & onboarding credits

Ben —

Thanks for the clear outline. A few quick data points from my side:
- We expect peak production traffic to land in July with a possible +45% spike vs board forecast for June.
- Procurement will want a price hold for the first 6 months (no upward repricing) given our ARR visibility.
- The $40k onboarding credit works well; can this be applied as an invoice credit rather than an annual rebate?
- For the burst protection: can we extend the waiver to 90 days if we commit to a multi-year option?

I’ve copied procurements@ascend.ai to start the procurement loop. Our primary constraints are predictable unit costs for Q3 and a simple amendment for accounting.

Would you be able to put the 90-day waiver + invoice credit option into a short term sheet so our procurement team can evaluate?

—Peter Lang
Head of Infrastructure
Ascend AI

On Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 09:14 AM Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Great catching up earlier this week...
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Ascend AI renewal & onboarding credits

FW: Ascend's asks (procurement loop included).

Monica / Karthik —
Quick summary and recommended internal posture before I respond to Peter/procurement:

1) They asked for
   - 6-month price hold -> escalate to finance: we can offer a 6-month effective price stability (no increases mid-term) if they take 12-month commit; alternatively, for multi-year commit we can extend more favorable pricing cadence.
   - Convert $40k onboarding credit to invoice credit -> low friction, acceptable.
   - 90-day burst waiver in exchange for multi-year -> we should treat 90-day as a concessional ask tied to a 24-month partial commit (e.g., initial 12-month commit + optional 12-month extension with predefined commit bands).

2) Proposed counter (simple, finance-friendly):
   - Keep 12-month primary term starting 2027-06-01.
   - Onboarding credit: $40k applied as invoice credit on first month (no accumulated rebate accounting).
   - Burst waiver: 60 days standard waiver on single-year; extend to 90 days if they sign a 24-month master amendment with a 10% discount step on months 13-24 (relative to months 1-12).
   - Price hold: commit to no upward pricing changes for first 6 months; add a clause to re-evaluate unit pricing at month 7 based on usage bands.

Notes: This protects our economics (90-day waiver for multi-year only) and gives them the predictability procurement needs. If approved, I can draft the small amendment and the DocuSign envelope.

Thoughts?
- Ben
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Peter Lang <peter@ascend.ai>, procurements@ascend.ai
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ascend AI renewal & onboarding credits

Peter / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and context. Per internal alignment with finance and legal, Redwood can offer the following formal concession package: 

1) Term & Commit
- Primary term: 12 months starting 2027-06-01.
- Commit: 1.2M inference units (as discussed).
2) Pricing bands
- Usage <= 70% of monthly commit: list rate.
- Usage between 70% and 100% of monthly commit: 5% discount on token price.
- Usage > 100% of monthly commit: overage rate = list * 0.90 (10% discounted overage).
3) Onboarding credit
- $40,000 one-time applied as an invoice credit against month 1. This will appear as a line-item on the first invoice.
4) Burst waiver
- 60-day no-charge burst waiver after production go-live for single-year amendment.
- 90-day waiver provided if Ascend signs a 24-month master amendment at time of signature; in that case months 13–24 will carry an additional 10% discount relative to months 1–12.
5) Price stability
- Redwood will not increase unit pricing during the first 6 months after go-live. Pricing after month 6 will be governed by the usage bands above and subject to a usage review.

Next steps:
- I’ve attached the draft term sheet (Ascend_Renewal_TermSheet_v2.pdf) and the Q1 usage snapshot you requested (ascend_usage_Q1_2027.csv).
- DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/track/ABC123456789
- HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/contacts/DEAL-43912

If that package maps to your procurement needs, we can send a 1‑page amendment for signature today and set the technical go-live window for the first week of June.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
